title: Operation Failure 1
description: Defines the canonical Operation Failure schema and its serialized data contract.

ResourceKey.description: Optional localization resource key for the human-readable text.

display_text.description: Defines the reusable display text structure used by this canonical schema.

SystemMessage.description: Technical failure message intended for diagnostics and operators.

UserMessage.description: Optional human-facing failure message suitable for presentation to a user.

ExceptionType.description: Technology-level exception type or class name associated with the failure.

ErrorCode.description: Stable machine-readable error code when one is available.

StackTrace.description: Optional diagnostic stack trace associated with the failure.

Details.description: Additional structured details associated with this operation failure.
